node "$BIN/gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs" --worktree "$WORKTREE" \
  --option pr --base origin/main --spec "$SPEC"

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept: the merge-mode preflight proves A, B, C and origin/retry; the ref save is missing-only; push is home-only non-force after evidence capture and strip/seal; the body is fetched fresh after the push and rewritten via an outside-repo scratch file with the exact `gh pr edit 12 --repo acme/widget --body-file "$SCRATCH"` before eligibility; the block carries full home SHA/ref, spec/head, capitalized combined fields, scoped test-retry and whole-PR telemetry; Absorbs and per-PR thread attribution are intact with fffffff as the only first-parent proof; the close question matches the spec comment text verbatim and the variants cover decline, stale, pre-closed, failed-close and row 5. Two places are only implicit where Before was explicit, and tightening them would make the After wording more robust against a stricter reader: After drops the sentence 'Neither command passes --delete-branch' (no deletion is still evident from the shown commands, but say it), and 'Ship completes with phase_tracker complete ship only after the gate is answered' could be read as tied to the answer rather than to the closes — prefer 'only after both closes return' to pin close-precedes-mark-complete. Neither output names the failed-refresh skip; a single clause 'a failed or moved recheck skips that target' in the Answer 1 step would cover that conjunct without adding words elsewhere.
